## Proposed entry or correction

Use the website contribution form for a structured proposal, or describe your contribution here.

- Source or dataset name:
- Access route and conditions (accounts, keys, fees, approval, restrictions):
- Geography and subjects:
- Available history, observation frequency and publication lag:
- Format, quality limitations and revision policy:
- Public documentation or evidence:
- Contributing IRP (optional):

For automatic application on approval, paste the proposal JSON into exactly one fenced `json` code block in this issue body. The website generates this automatically. Attachment-only or free-text requests must be converted to that format before approval.

Maintainers: review the metadata, then add `inventory-approved` to apply it and publish automatically. Do not include credentials, licensed data or private contact details.
